words.enDefinition: A Christian festival marking Jesus's birth, also celebrated through many cultural traditions.

examples.en: My flatmate invited me to spend Christmas with her family while campus was quiet.
examples.zh: 学校里人少的时候，室友邀请我和她家人一起过「圣诞节」。

examples.en: We asked classmates how they celebrate Christmas, and several described very different family traditions.
examples.zh: 我们问同学怎么过「圣诞节」，几个人讲的家庭习俗各不相同。

words.enDefinition: The evening or calendar day immediately before Christmas Day.

examples.en: We picked up pastries on Christmas Eve because our usual cafe would be closed the next day.
examples.zh: 「平安夜」那天，我们买了些酥点，因为常去的咖啡馆第二天不开门。

examples.en: My neighbor spent Christmas Eve singing with a choir at the local community center.
examples.zh: 邻居在当地社区中心跟合唱团一起唱歌，度过了「平安夜」。

words.enDefinition: The calendar day on which a community celebrates Christmas.

examples.en: The residence desk posted different opening hours for Christmas Day and the weekend after it.
examples.zh: 宿舍前台公布的「圣诞节当天」开放时间和随后那个周末的不一样。

examples.en: Some of us went for a walk on Christmas Day before sharing lunch together.
examples.zh: 「圣诞节当天」，我们几个人先去散步，然后一起吃了午饭。

words.enDefinition: The day following Christmas Day, observed in the UK and some other countries.

examples.en: The British student in our flat went for a long walk on Boxing Day.
examples.zh: 我们公寓的那位英国同学在「节礼日」出去走了很久。

examples.en: The shopping center near our Canadian campus posted shorter opening hours for Boxing Day.
examples.zh: 我们加拿大校区附近的购物中心贴了告示，「节礼日」营业时间较短。

words.enDefinition: The period of preparation before Christmas in many Christian traditions.

examples.en: The chapel displayed a special notice about Advent beside its regular weekly schedule for students.
examples.zh: 校园礼拜堂在面向学生的每周日程旁贴了一则关于「将临期」的专门通知。

examples.en: My roommate explained how her family marks Advent while we walked past the chapel.
examples.zh: 经过礼拜堂时，室友介绍了她家如何度过「将临期」。

words.enDefinition: A calendar with daily openings or surprises counting down to Christmas.

examples.en: My roommate put an Advent calendar with tiny chocolate shapes on the kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 室友把一份装有小块造型巧克力的「圣诞倒数日历」放在厨房架子上。

examples.en: We noticed a reusable Advent calendar with little drawers in the window near campus.
examples.zh: 我们在校园附近的橱窗里看到一份有小抽屉、可重复使用的「圣诞倒数日历」。

words.enDefinition: A wreath with candles used to mark the weeks before Christmas in some Christian traditions.

examples.en: The chapel placed an Advent wreath beside a note explaining the meaning of its candles.
examples.zh: 礼拜堂摆了一只「将临期花环」，旁边的说明讲了蜡烛的含义。

examples.en: We saw an Advent wreath on the table while helping with the winter exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们帮忙筹备冬季展览时，看见桌上有一只「将临期花环」。

collocations: a candle on the Advent wreath

words.enDefinition: A greeting wishing someone an enjoyable Christmas.

examples.en: My neighbor said “Merry Christmas” as he brought in the parcels from the front step.
examples.zh: 邻居把门前台阶上的包裹搬进来时说了声「圣诞快乐」。

examples.en: I wrote “Merry Christmas” on the card for the classmate who invited me over.
examples.zh: 我在写给邀请我去她家做客的同学的卡片上写了「圣诞快乐」。

words.enDefinition: A written greeting offering good wishes during the year-end holidays.

examples.en: The library email ended with “Season's greetings” and a note about December opening hours.
examples.zh: 图书馆的邮件以「致以节日问候」结尾，还附上了十二月的开放时间。

examples.en: A card reading “Season's greetings” stood on the counter beside the residence front desk.
examples.zh: 宿舍前台旁的柜台上立着一张写有「致以节日问候」的卡片。

words.enDefinition: A greeting that offers good wishes during the holiday season without naming one holiday.

examples.en: Our tutor said “Happy holidays” after our final seminar before the winter break began.
examples.zh: 寒假前最后一节研讨课结束后，导师祝我们「节日快乐」。

examples.en: I wrote “Happy holidays” in the group chat before everyone left campus for their break.
examples.zh: 大家离校休假前，我在群聊里写了句「节日快乐」。

words.enDefinition: The part of the year around several late-year holidays, especially in North American usage.

examples.en: The student center stayed open on selected days during the holiday season for residents.
examples.zh: 「年末节庆时段」，学生活动中心选了几天对住户开放。

examples.en: My roommate worked extra shifts at the campus bookstore during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 「年末节庆时段」，室友在校园书店多上了几个班。

collocations: the start of the holiday season

words.enDefinition: A market selling seasonal food, decorations, or goods in the period before Christmas.

examples.en: We walked through the Christmas market after our last lecture and bought hot drinks.
examples.zh: 我们上完最后一节课后逛了「圣诞集市」，还买了热饮。

examples.en: The Christmas market near campus had several stalls run by local makers and student groups.
examples.zh: 校园附近的「圣诞集市」有几个由本地手工艺者和学生团体经营的摊位。

collocations: a stall at the Christmas market

words.enDefinition: A natural or artificial evergreen tree displayed and decorated at Christmas.

examples.en: The residents put up a Christmas tree in the lounge before the last week of term.
examples.zh: 学期最后一周前，住户们在休息室里摆了一棵「圣诞树」。

examples.en: Our small Christmas tree fit on the windowsill beside the plants my roommate looks after.
examples.zh: 我们的小「圣诞树」刚好能放在窗台上，挨着室友照料的植物。

words.enDefinition: Decorative lights displayed around Christmas, often on trees, homes, or public streets.

examples.en: We went to see the Christmas lights downtown after our group finished its presentation.
examples.zh: 小组完成展示后，我们去市中心看了「圣诞彩灯」。

examples.en: The Christmas lights in our neighbor's window made the courtyard feel cheerful during the break.
examples.zh: 放假期间，邻居窗户上的「圣诞彩灯」让庭院更热闹了。

words.enDefinition: A decorative object usually hung on a Christmas tree.

examples.en: I made a Christmas ornament from recycled paper at the craft table in our lounge.
examples.zh: 我在休息室的手工桌上用再生纸做了一个「圣诞树挂饰」。

examples.en: The Christmas ornament shaped like a small book came from a stall near the library.
examples.zh: 那个像一本小书的「圣诞树挂饰」是从图书馆附近的摊位买的。

words.enDefinition: A decorative object placed at the top of a Christmas tree.

examples.en: The art students made a paper star to use as the tree topper this year.
examples.zh: 美术专业的同学做了一颗纸星星，作为今年的「圣诞树顶饰」。

examples.en: Our tree topper was so light that it leaned over when someone opened the window.
examples.zh: 我们的「圣诞树顶饰」很轻，有人一开窗它就歪了。

words.enDefinition: A decorative cloth spread around the base of a Christmas tree.

examples.en: The library volunteers placed a green tree skirt around the base of their small display.
examples.zh: 图书馆志愿者在小型展示树的底部围了一块绿色的「圣诞树底围布」。

examples.en: We borrowed a tree skirt from my flatmate to hide the stand in the lounge.
examples.zh: 我们向室友借了块「圣诞树底围布」，遮住休息室里圣诞树的支架。

collocations: a tree skirt around the stand

words.enDefinition: A circular decoration displayed at Christmas, often made with greenery.

examples.en: Our neighbors hung a Christmas wreath on their door before leaving for the winter break.
examples.zh: 邻居们放寒假离开前，在门上挂了一个「圣诞花环」。

examples.en: I noticed a Christmas wreath with dried orange slices in the community center lobby.
examples.zh: 我在社区中心大厅看到一个带干橙片的「圣诞花环」。

collocations: a Christmas wreath on the door

words.enDefinition: Thin, shiny strips used as festive decoration, especially on Christmas trees.

examples.en: There was silver tinsel around the window of the cafe where our study group met.
examples.zh: 我们自习小组碰面的咖啡馆在窗户边上围了银色的「圣诞装饰亮丝」。

examples.en: My roommate saved the tinsel in a paper bag for next year's holiday decorations.
examples.zh: 室友把「圣诞装饰亮丝」收在纸袋里，留着明年过节再用。

words.enDefinition: A plant sometimes hung as a Christmas decoration and associated with a kissing custom.

examples.en: Our guide pointed out mistletoe above the doorway during a tour of the historic house.
examples.zh: 参观历史建筑时，向导指给我们看门口悬挂的「槲寄生」。

examples.en: The craft display used paper mistletoe among its examples of traditional decorations for students.
examples.zh: 手工展览给学生展示传统装饰，其中放了用纸做的「槲寄生」。

words.enDefinition: A plant with colorful upper leaves, commonly used as a Christmas decoration.

examples.en: A potted poinsettia stood beside the sign for the residence hall's December opening hours.
examples.zh: 宿舍楼十二月开放时间的告示旁摆着一盆「一品红」。

examples.en: My flatmate recognized the poinsettia in the window because her family displays one at Christmas.
examples.zh: 室友认出了橱窗里的「一品红」，因为她家圣诞节也会摆一盆。

words.enDefinition: A large decorative sock hung at Christmas to hold small gifts.

examples.en: My neighbor's Christmas stocking had her name sewn on it in bright red thread.
examples.zh: 邻居的「圣诞袜」上用鲜红的线绣了她的名字。

examples.en: The language club displayed a Christmas stocking beside examples of traditions from other winter holidays.
examples.zh: 语言社摆了一只「圣诞袜」，旁边展示了其他冬季节日的习俗。

collocations: a Christmas stocking by the fireplace

words.enDefinition: A small gift intended to go inside a Christmas stocking.

examples.en: My flatmate used a tiny notebook as a stocking stuffer for her younger brother.
examples.zh: 室友把一本迷你笔记本当作「塞进圣诞袜的小礼物」送给弟弟。

examples.en: A stall at the market sold small soaps and described each as a stocking stuffer.
examples.zh: 集市有个摊位卖小块香皂，称每块都适合当「塞进圣诞袜的小礼物」。

collocations: use something as a stocking stuffer

words.enDefinition: A traditional Christmas character said to bring gifts to children.

examples.en: A volunteer dressed as Santa Claus handed out stickers at the library's family event.
examples.zh: 图书馆办家庭活动时，一位扮成「圣诞老人」的志愿者发了贴纸。

examples.en: The museum label compared several drawings of Santa Claus from different countries and time periods.
examples.zh: 博物馆的展签对比了不同国家、不同时期画的几幅「圣诞老人」画像。

words.zhGloss: 匿名交换圣诞礼物活动
words.enDefinition: A gift exchange in which each participant secretly gives a present to one assigned person.
acceptedZhAnswers: 匿名交换圣诞礼物活动

examples.en: Our floor organized a Secret Santa and agreed on a small spending limit in advance.
examples.zh: 我们楼层办了「匿名交换圣诞礼物活动」，提前说好不要花太多钱。

examples.en: I signed up for Secret Santa before the deadline because I would still be on campus.
examples.zh: 截止前我报名了「匿名交换圣诞礼物活动」，因为到时候我还会留在学校。

collocations: draw a name for Secret Santa

words.enDefinition: A party game where people may open wrapped gifts or take gifts already opened by others.

examples.en: My classmate explained the white elephant gift exchange before we sat in a circle.
examples.zh: 我们围坐成一圈前，同学讲了「白象交换礼物活动」的玩法。

examples.en: Our residence held a white elephant gift exchange using wrapped items we already owned.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍用大家已有的物品包装成礼物，办了场「白象交换礼物活动」。

collocations: organize a white elephant gift exchange
join a white elephant gift exchange
rules for a white elephant gift exchange

words.enDefinition: A traditional song sung during the Christmas season.

examples.en: The campus choir sang a Christmas carol during its winter performance in the main hall.
examples.zh: 校园合唱团在大厅举行冬季演出时，唱了一首「圣诞颂歌」。

examples.en: I recognized a Christmas carol playing quietly while we waited at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我们在公交站等车时，我听出轻轻播放的是一首「圣诞颂歌」。

words.enDefinition: To go out with others to sing Christmas songs in public or to neighbors.

examples.en: Some students planned to go caroling with the choir at a nearby community center.
examples.zh: 有些学生计划和合唱团一起去附近的社区中心「唱圣诞颂歌」。

examples.en: My neighbor asked whether I wanted to go caroling with her group after class.
examples.zh: 邻居问我下课后愿不愿跟她们那群人一起去「唱圣诞颂歌」。

words.enDefinition: A wrapped paper novelty used at Christmas meals in Britain and elsewhere, often containing a paper crown or small gift.

examples.en: There was a Christmas cracker beside each plate at the community center's holiday lunch.
examples.zh: 社区中心举办节日午餐时，每个盘子旁都有一个「圣诞拉炮」。

examples.en: My British flatmate showed me the paper crown that came from her Christmas cracker.
examples.zh: 我的英国室友给我看了她的「圣诞拉炮」里附的纸王冠。

collocations: a joke from a Christmas cracker
a Christmas cracker at each place

words.enDefinition: A display depicting the birth of Jesus in the Christian Christmas story.

examples.en: The museum displayed a small nativity scene in its exhibition about winter traditions in Europe.
examples.zh: 博物馆在欧洲冬季习俗展中摆了一组小型「耶稣诞生场景」。

examples.en: I saw a handmade nativity scene while visiting the chapel with my history class.
examples.zh: 我跟历史课同学参观礼拜堂时，看到了一组手工制作的「耶稣诞生场景」。

words.enDefinition: A Mass traditionally celebrated at night on Christmas Eve in some Christian churches.

examples.en: My classmate went to midnight Mass with her family after their evening meal at home.
examples.zh: 在家吃完晚饭后，同学跟家人去参加了「圣诞夜子夜弥撒」。

examples.en: The church notice listed midnight Mass separately from its service earlier that same evening.
examples.zh: 教堂告示将「圣诞夜子夜弥撒」和当晚较早的一场礼拜分开列出。

words.enDefinition: A family stage show, often based on a fairy tale, performed around Christmas in Britain.

examples.en: A British classmate suggested seeing a Christmas pantomime at the small theater near our university.
examples.zh: 一位英国同学提议去学校附近的小剧院看「英式圣诞喜剧」。

examples.en: The local theater advertised its Christmas pantomime on a poster beside our campus bus stop.
examples.zh: 当地剧院在校园公交站旁的海报上宣传「英式圣诞喜剧」。

words.enDefinition: A small sweet pie usually filled with spiced dried fruit and served at Christmas in Britain.

examples.en: I tried a mince pie at the market after a classmate told me about its sweet filling.
examples.zh: 同学告诉我里面是甜馅后，我在集市尝了一个「圣诞甜果馅饼」。

examples.en: Our British neighbor put a mince pie beside each cup of tea she served.
examples.zh: 英国邻居端茶来时，在每杯茶旁放了一个「圣诞甜果馅饼」。

words.enDefinition: A dense fruit dessert traditionally served at Christmas in Britain and some other places.

examples.en: My flatmate brought Christmas pudding to the lounge and explained what her family puts in it.
examples.zh: 室友把「圣诞布丁」带到休息室，讲了她家都用些什么做。

examples.en: One table at the winter fair offered Christmas pudding alongside other desserts chosen by students.
examples.zh: 冬季集市有一桌供应「圣诞布丁」，也有同学们挑的其他甜点。

words.enDefinition: A small model house made from gingerbread and decorated with icing or sweets.

examples.en: The residents decorated a gingerbread house with white icing at the winter craft session.
examples.zh: 冬季手工活动中，住户们用白色糖霜装饰了一个「姜饼屋」。

examples.en: Our department displayed a gingerbread house made by students beside the reception desk in December.
examples.zh: 十二月，我们院系在接待处旁展出了同学们做的一个「姜饼屋」。

words.enDefinition: A rich drink made with eggs and dairy, often served around Christmas in North America.

examples.en: We tried nonalcoholic eggnog at the gathering in our Canadian residence before the break.
examples.zh: 放假前，我们在加拿大宿舍的聚会上尝了无酒精的「节庆蛋奶饮」。

examples.en: My roommate had a cup of eggnog while we looked through the winter fair stalls.
examples.zh: 我们在冬季集市逛摊位时，室友喝了一杯「节庆蛋奶饮」。

words.enDefinition: A deliberately gaudy or humorous sweater worn for Christmas festivities.

examples.en: My roommate borrowed an ugly Christmas sweater for the gathering in our residence lounge.
examples.zh: 室友借了件「搞怪圣诞毛衣」，准备参加宿舍休息室的聚会。

examples.en: The campus shop displayed an ugly Christmas sweater with a giant snowman on the front.
examples.zh: 校园商店展出了一件「搞怪圣诞毛衣」，正面印着个大雪人。

words.enDefinition: An eight-day Jewish festival observed with lights and a range of household traditions.

examples.en: A classmate told us how her family celebrates Hanukkah when our seminar discussed winter festivals.
examples.zh: 研讨课谈到冬季节日时，一位同学讲了她家怎么过「光明节」。

examples.en: The student center listed a public event for Hanukkah alongside several other December activities.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心公布了几项十二月活动，其中有一场面向公众的「光明节」活动。

words.enDefinition: A greeting offering good wishes to someone observing Hanukkah.

examples.en: I wrote “Happy Hanukkah” in a note for my flatmate before she went home.
examples.zh: 室友回家之前，我给她留了张纸条，写着「光明节快乐」。

examples.en: The banner said “Happy Hanukkah” above a table with books about the Jewish festival.
examples.zh: 摆放犹太节日书籍的桌子上方，横幅写着「光明节快乐」。

collocations: write Happy Hanukkah in a card

words.enDefinition: A nine-branched lamp or candleholder used during Hanukkah.

examples.en: We saw a Hanukkah menorah in the window while walking back from our tutorial.
examples.zh: 辅导课下课走回去时，我们在一扇窗户里看到一座「光明节九枝烛台」。

examples.en: The museum guide compared a modern Hanukkah menorah with an older metal example from its collection.
examples.zh: 博物馆导览员把一座现代「光明节九枝烛台」和馆藏的一座旧金属烛台作了对照。

collocations: a Hanukkah menorah in the window
a Hanukkah menorah in the exhibition

words.enDefinition: The helper light used to light the other lights on a Hanukkah menorah.

examples.en: My classmate pointed out the shamash in a photograph of her family's Hanukkah menorah.
examples.zh: 同学在她家光明节烛台的照片里指给我看哪一支是「光明节引火烛」。

examples.en: The museum label explained why the shamash had a separate place on the lamp.
examples.zh: 博物馆展签说明了「光明节引火烛」为什么在烛台上有单独的位置。

words.enDefinition: An occasion when the lights on a Hanukkah menorah are lit.

examples.en: We stopped by the public menorah lighting in the square after our evening lecture.
examples.zh: 上完晚课，我们去了广场上面向公众的「光明节烛台点灯仪式」。

examples.en: The campus notice listed the menorah lighting and a short talk by a student group.
examples.zh: 校园告示上列出了「光明节烛台点灯仪式」及一个学生团体的简短分享。

words.enDefinition: A blessing said on an occasion when ceremonial candles are lit.

examples.en: At the Hanukkah event, a student explained the candle-lighting blessing before people gathered downstairs.
examples.zh: 光明节活动中，大家下楼集合前，一位同学先介绍了「点烛祝祷」。

examples.en: A booklet for visitors included a translation of the candle-lighting blessing used that evening.
examples.zh: 访客手册上有当晚所用「点烛祝祷」的译文。

words.enDefinition: Money traditionally given at Hanukkah, often to children in the family.

examples.en: My flatmate said her grandparents used to give her Hanukkah gelt when she was little.
examples.zh: 室友说，她小时候祖父母会给她「光明节零钱」。

examples.en: A student presentation mentioned Hanukkah gelt alongside other traditions that vary from family to family.
examples.zh: 同学做展示时提到了「光明节零钱」，还讲了其他因家庭而异的习俗。

words.enDefinition: Foil-wrapped chocolate coins often given or used in games during Hanukkah.

examples.en: My flatmate brought chocolate gelt to the common room along with a small wooden top.
examples.zh: 室友带了「光明节巧克力金币」和一个小木陀螺到公共休息室。

examples.en: We found chocolate gelt in the campus market beside a sign explaining the holiday.
examples.zh: 我们在校园集市看到了「光明节巧克力金币」，旁边有牌子介绍这个节日。

words.enDefinition: A four-sided top with Hebrew letters used in a traditional Hanukkah game.

examples.en: A student showed us a wooden dreidel at the activity table in the library.
examples.zh: 一位同学在图书馆的活动桌上给我们看了一个木制「光明节四面陀螺」。

examples.en: We watched the dreidel spin across the table while our classmate explained the Hebrew letters.
examples.zh: 同学介绍上面的希伯来字母时，我们看着「光明节四面陀螺」转过桌面。

words.enDefinition: A fried pancake, commonly made from grated potatoes and associated with Hanukkah.

examples.en: I tried a latke with applesauce at the winter gathering in our residence hall.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍楼的冬季聚会上尝了「犹太式炸土豆饼」配苹果酱。

examples.en: My classmate put a latke on each plate while setting out food for visitors.
examples.zh: 同学为来访的人摆餐时，在每个盘子里放了一块「犹太式炸土豆饼」。

words.enDefinition: Jelly-filled doughnuts traditionally eaten at Hanukkah, particularly in Israel.

examples.en: Our neighbor brought a box of sufganiyot when she came to the winter craft evening.
examples.zh: 邻居晚上来参加冬季手工活动时，带来一盒「光明节果酱甜甜圈」。

examples.en: A card next to the sufganiyot explained their connection with Hanukkah at the student fair.
examples.zh: 学生集市上，「光明节果酱甜甜圈」旁的卡片说明了它们和光明节的关系。

words.enDefinition: Candles used in the traditional Hanukkah lamp or candleholder during the festival.

examples.en: We noticed a box of Hanukkah candles beside the holiday books in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我们在校园商店节日图书旁看到一盒「光明节蜡烛」。

examples.en: The display showed several kinds of Hanukkah candles next to a picture of a lamp.
examples.zh: 展览在一张烛台图片旁摆出了几种「光明节蜡烛」。

words.enDefinition: A traditional Hebrew song sung by many people during Hanukkah.

examples.en: The campus choir included Ma'oz Tzur in its program for the winter music evening.
examples.zh: 校园合唱团把「光明节歌曲《坚固磐石》」列入了冬季音乐会的节目单。

examples.en: My roommate recognized Ma'oz Tzur because she had heard her family sing it at Hanukkah.
examples.zh: 室友认出了「光明节歌曲《坚固磐石》」，因为她听过家人在光明节唱这首歌。

words.enDefinition: A week-long African American and Pan-African holiday honoring African heritage and community.

examples.en: The library set up a display about Kwanzaa beside its books on winter traditions.
examples.zh: 图书馆在冬季习俗图书旁设置了「宽扎节」展区。

examples.en: A classmate explained how his family celebrates Kwanzaa when we planned a year-end exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们筹划年末展览时，一位同学介绍了他家如何过「宽扎节」。

words.enDefinition: A greeting offering good wishes to someone celebrating Kwanzaa.

examples.en: A greeting card on the community table said “Happy Kwanzaa” in three bright colors.
examples.zh: 社区活动桌上的一张贺卡用三种亮色写着「宽扎节快乐」。

examples.en: The volunteer said “Happy Kwanzaa” as she greeted families arriving for the evening program.
examples.zh: 志愿者迎接来参加晚间活动的家庭时，和他们说「宽扎节快乐」。

words.enDefinition: A Swahili question used as a traditional Kwanzaa greeting, answered with the day's principle.

examples.en: The guide used “Habari Gani?” to open a discussion of the day's Kwanzaa principle.
examples.zh: 导览员用「今日有什么消息？」开场，带大家讨论当天的宽扎节原则。

examples.en: I saw “Habari Gani?” printed above an explanation of the greeting at the exhibit.
examples.zh: 展览上，问候语的说明上方写着「今日有什么消息？」。

words.enDefinition: The Swahili name for the seven principles celebrated during Kwanzaa.

examples.en: The program listed the Nguzo Saba in Swahili and English beside the event schedule.
examples.zh: 节目单在日程旁用斯瓦希里语和英语列出了「宽扎节七项原则」。

examples.en: Our reading group talked about the Nguzo Saba after visiting the local history museum.
examples.zh: 参观当地历史博物馆后，我们读书小组谈到了「宽扎节七项原则」。

collocations: an exhibit about the Nguzo Saba

words.enDefinition: A candleholder with space for seven candles used in Kwanzaa celebrations.

examples.en: A wooden kinara stood on the display table in the student center's winter exhibition.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心的冬季展上，陈列桌上摆着一座木制「宽扎节七枝烛台」。

examples.en: My classmate explained the kinara to visitors who had never seen one before.
examples.zh: 同学向头一次见到「宽扎节七枝烛台」的访客介绍了它。

words.enDefinition: A mat used as the base for the symbolic objects displayed at Kwanzaa.

examples.en: The volunteer laid out a woven mkeka before putting the other objects on the table.
examples.zh: 志愿者先铺好编织的「宽扎节陈设用席垫」，再把其他物品摆上桌。

examples.en: We noticed the mkeka in a photograph accompanying the article for our culture class.
examples.zh: 我们在文化课阅读材料配的一张照片里留意到了「宽扎节陈设用席垫」。

words.enDefinition: The seven candles used in the Kwanzaa candleholder to represent the festival's principles.

examples.en: The poster showed the colors of the mishumaa saba beside a picture of the candleholder.
examples.zh: 海报在烛台图片旁标明了「宽扎节七支蜡烛」的颜色。

examples.en: We learned about the mishumaa saba while helping label the objects in the campus exhibit.
examples.zh: 我们协助给校园展品写标签时，了解了「宽扎节七支蜡烛」。

collocations: the colors of the mishumaa saba

words.enDefinition: A cup used in some Kwanzaa observances as a symbol of unity.

examples.en: The campus exhibit labeled the cup as kikombe cha umoja and explained its symbolic meaning.
examples.zh: 校园展览把这只杯子标为「宽扎节团结杯」，还解释了它的象征含义。

examples.en: I asked about the kikombe cha umoja when we looked at the community center's display.
examples.zh: 看社区中心的展览时，我问了问「宽扎节团结杯」。

collocations: learn about the kikombe cha umoja

words.enDefinition: A communal feast held as part of Kwanzaa observances.

examples.en: My neighbor invited two students to a Karamu at the community center across the road.
examples.zh: 邻居邀请两位同学去马路对面的社区中心参加「宽扎节团聚宴」。

examples.en: The program listed a Karamu after the afternoon readings and performances in the main hall.
examples.zh: 节目单上写着，大厅下午的朗读和表演之后有一场「宽扎节团聚宴」。

words.enDefinition: The ears of corn displayed at Kwanzaa to represent children.

examples.en: A student volunteer wrote the label for the muhindi in our winter traditions display.
examples.zh: 一位学生志愿者为我们的冬季习俗展写了介绍「宽扎节陈设中的玉米」的展签。

examples.en: The display placed the muhindi next to a card describing the festival's focus on family.
examples.zh: 展览把「宽扎节陈设中的玉米」放在一张介绍宽扎节重视家庭的卡片旁。

words.enDefinition: The crops or produce displayed during Kwanzaa to symbolize the harvest.

examples.en: The fruit on the exhibit table was labeled mazao, with an explanation about the harvest.
examples.zh: 展桌上的水果标为「宽扎节陈设中的农产」，说明文字提到了收获。

examples.en: We asked what the mazao represented while touring the exhibition with our seminar group.
examples.zh: 随研讨班参观展览时，我们问「宽扎节陈设中的农产」代表什么。

words.enDefinition: Gifts given during Kwanzaa that can express care or encourage learning and creativity.

examples.en: A classmate put a handmade bookmark on the exhibit table as an example of zawadi.
examples.zh: 有位同学把手工书签摆在展桌上，作为「宽扎节礼物」的一个例子。

examples.en: The community workshop showed students how families might choose books as zawadi during Kwanzaa.
examples.zh: 社区活动给同学们介绍，有些家庭会选书籍作「宽扎节礼物」。

words.enDefinition: The last day or evening of the calendar year just before New Year's Day.

examples.en: We planned to spend New Year's Eve in the lounge with a couple of classmates.
examples.zh: 我们打算和几位同学在休息室里过「跨年夜」。

examples.en: My neighbors stayed in on New Year's Eve because they had guests visiting from abroad.
examples.zh: 邻居有客人从国外来访，所以他们「跨年夜」留在家里。

words.enDefinition: The first day of the new year in the Gregorian calendar.

examples.en: Some classmates met for breakfast on New Year's Day before the library opened again.
examples.zh: 「公历元旦」那天，几位同学在图书馆重新开放前约着吃了早饭。

examples.en: The apartment building was unusually quiet on New Year's Day after the celebrations downtown.
examples.zh: 市中心的庆祝活动过后，公寓楼在「公历元旦」那天格外安静。

collocations: a meal on New Year's Day

words.enDefinition: A greeting wishing someone a happy start to a new year.

examples.en: Our friends called out “Happy New Year” when the clock in the lounge reached midnight.
examples.zh: 休息室里的钟走到午夜时，朋友们喊起了「新年快乐」。

examples.en: I sent “Happy New Year” to my flatmate after she got home for the break.
examples.zh: 室友回家过假期后，我给她发了句「新年快乐」。

collocations: wish someone a Happy New Year
a message reading Happy New Year

words.enDefinition: To mark the beginning of the new year with a celebration.

examples.en: We decided to ring in the new year together instead of traveling across town tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们决定一起「迎接新年」，不往城另一头跑了。

examples.en: A few students met on campus to ring in the new year with hot drinks.
examples.zh: 几位同学在校园碰面，端着热饮一起「迎接新年」。

collocations: ring in the new year together
ring in the new year with friends
gather to ring in the new year

words.enDefinition: The counting of the last seconds before the clock reaches midnight.

examples.en: We heard the midnight countdown from the courtyard while checking the clock on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在看手机时间，就听见庭院里开始了「午夜倒计时」。

examples.en: Our residence lounge showed the midnight countdown on a screen next to the main window.
examples.zh: 宿舍休息室靠大窗户的屏幕上播放着「午夜倒计时」。

words.enDefinition: To reach twelve at night and mark the time with a clock's sound.

examples.en: Some classmates waited to hear the clock strike midnight from the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 几位同学在山顶等着听「敲钟报午夜」。

examples.en: The host waited for the clock to strike midnight before greeting viewers on camera.
examples.zh: 主持人等到钟「敲响午夜」后才对着镜头和观众打招呼。

collocations: wait for the clock to strike midnight

words.enDefinition: A toast made at midnight to mark the start of the new year.

examples.en: We used sparkling apple juice for a midnight toast in the residence lounge that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，我们在宿舍休息室用苹果气泡饮料「午夜举杯庆祝」。

examples.en: My neighbor made a short midnight toast before everyone called their families back home.
examples.zh: 大家给家人打电话前，邻居在「午夜举杯庆祝」，说了几句祝福。

words.enDefinition: A promise or goal that someone sets for the year ahead.

examples.en: My New Year's resolution was to call home more often during busy weeks at university.
examples.zh: 我「新年立下的目标」是，在学校忙的时候也要多给家里打电话。

examples.en: We each wrote a New Year's resolution on a card for our future selves.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都在给未来自己的卡片上写下了一个「新年立下的目标」。

words.enDefinition: A summary of important events or achievements from the year that is ending.

examples.en: Our student newspaper published a year in review with photos from club events and exhibitions.
examples.zh: 学生报发表了「年度回顾」，放了社团活动和展览的照片。

examples.en: We watched the year in review while waiting for the end of term concert to start.
examples.zh: 我们一边等学期末音乐会开场，一边看「年度回顾」。

collocations: look through the year in review

words.enDefinition: A gathering or event held to mark the end of the year.

examples.en: Our residence held an end-of-year celebration before students began heading home for the winter break.
examples.zh: 同学们开始陆续回家过寒假前，宿舍办了一场「年末庆祝活动」。

examples.en: We saw neighbors from across the area at the end-of-year celebration in the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园的「年末庆祝活动」上见到了附近各处的邻居。

words.enDefinition: A New Year's Eve ceremony in which a large illuminated ball is lowered toward midnight.

examples.en: We watched the ball drop in Times Square on a screen at our neighbor's apartment.
examples.zh: 我们在邻居家用屏幕看了纽约时报广场的「跨年灯球降落仪式」。

examples.en: My roommate asked why the ball drop was part of the New Year's Eve broadcast.
examples.zh: 室友问，跨年夜转播为什么包含「跨年灯球降落仪式」。

collocations: a livestream of the ball drop

words.enDefinition: A public display of fireworks timed to mark midnight, especially on New Year's Eve.

examples.en: We watched the midnight fireworks from the hill near campus after finishing our board game.
examples.zh: 结束桌游后，我们从校园附近的山坡看了「午夜烟花表演」。

examples.en: The midnight fireworks were visible from several dorm windows across the river that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，从河对岸的几扇宿舍窗户可以看到「午夜烟花表演」。

collocations: a view of the midnight fireworks
a broadcast of the midnight fireworks

words.enDefinition: A Scots song widely sung at gatherings to mark the start of a new year.

examples.en: Some neighbors sang Auld Lang Syne after midnight in the courtyard of our apartment building.
examples.zh: 过了午夜，几位邻居在公寓楼的庭院里唱起了「《友谊地久天长》」。

examples.en: A Scottish classmate recognized Auld Lang Syne when the choir began singing it near midnight.
examples.zh: 临近午夜，合唱团一开口，一位苏格兰同学就听出了是「《友谊地久天长》」。

collocations: a recording of Auld Lang Syne

words.enDefinition: The Scottish name for New Year's Eve and its celebrations.

examples.en: My classmate told us about Hogmanay when we met at her room for tea.
examples.zh: 我去同学房间喝茶时，她给我们讲了「苏格兰除夕庆典」。

examples.en: The university notice advertised a Hogmanay gathering for students staying in town during the break.
examples.zh: 大学的告示为放假留在城里的学生宣传了一场「苏格兰除夕庆典」。

words.enDefinition: A Scottish New Year custom centered on the first visitor to a home after midnight.

examples.en: A Scottish neighbor explained first-footing while showing us photos from her family's New Year gathering.
examples.zh: 一位苏格兰邻居一边给我们看她家新年聚会的照片，一边介绍「苏格兰新年首访习俗」。

examples.en: We read about first-footing in a booklet at the community center's winter traditions display.
examples.zh: 我们在社区中心的冬季习俗展上，从一本小册子里读到了「苏格兰新年首访习俗」。

words.enDefinition: A public procession held to celebrate the first day of the calendar year.

examples.en: Our student band rehearsed a march before performing in the local New Year's Day parade.
examples.zh: 学生乐队在当地「元旦巡游」演出前排练了一首进行曲。

examples.en: We stood near the campus gate to watch the New Year's Day parade pass by.
examples.zh: 我们站在校门附近，看「元旦巡游」队伍经过。

collocations: watch a New Year's Day parade
a costume for a New Year's Day parade
perform in a New Year's Day parade

words.enDefinition: A public cold-water swim often held on New Year's Day in places such as Vancouver.

examples.en: My roommate sent a photo of spectators watching a polar bear swim on New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 室友发来照片，里面是元旦当天围观「新年冬泳活动」的人。

examples.en: The museum displayed an old poster for a polar bear swim beside other New Year traditions.
examples.zh: 博物馆陈列了一张「新年冬泳活动」的旧海报，旁边还有其他新年习俗的展品。

collocations: a poster for a polar bear swim

words.enDefinition: A pause in classes or work during winter, often near the year-end holidays.

examples.en: A few of our friends are staying on campus during winter break to finish projects.
examples.zh: 我们有几位朋友「寒假」会留在学校把项目做完。

examples.en: The residence held a welcome dinner for students returning from winter break on Sunday.
examples.zh: 星期天，宿舍为「寒假」返校的学生办了一场欢迎晚餐。

collocations: stay on campus over winter break

words.enDefinition: Describes someone spending the holiday period at home, often with family.

examples.en: I decided to go home for the holidays after my final exam ended early.
examples.zh: 最后一场考试提前结束，我决定「回家过节」。

examples.en: My roommate planned to be home for the holidays but return before classes started again.
examples.zh: 室友计划「回家过节」，开课前再回来。

words.enDefinition: A public event to turn on a town's Christmas lights, especially in British usage.

examples.en: We stopped at the Christmas lights switch-on after a classmate finished work at the cafe.
examples.zh: 同学在咖啡馆下班后，我们顺路看了「圣诞彩灯点亮仪式」。

examples.en: A student choir was listed on the program for the town's Christmas lights switch-on.
examples.zh: 镇上「圣诞彩灯点亮仪式」的节目单上列出了一个学生合唱团。

collocations: a poster for the Christmas lights switch-on

words.enDefinition: A walking route lined with light displays at a winter event.

examples.en: We followed a winter light trail through the gardens with friends from our residence.
examples.zh: 我们跟宿舍的朋友沿着「冬季灯光步道」逛了花园。

examples.en: The campus paper reviewed a winter light trail set up in the park across town.
examples.zh: 校报对城另一头公园布置的「冬季灯光步道」写了篇评论。

collocations: tickets for the winter light trail

words.enDefinition: An artwork carved or shaped from ice, often displayed at winter festivals.

examples.en: A large ice sculpture stood near the entrance to the winter festival by campus.
examples.zh: 校园附近的冬季节庆活动入口旁摆了一座大型「冰雕」。

examples.en: My classmate snapped a photo of the ice sculpture shaped like an open book.
examples.zh: 同学拍下了那座形状像一本打开的书的「冰雕」。

collocations: an ice sculpture at a winter festival

words.enDefinition: A warm apple cider flavored with spices, often served at winter gatherings.

examples.en: We bought mulled cider from a winter market stall before heading back to campus.
examples.zh: 回学校之前，我们在冬季集市的摊位买了「热香料苹果饮」。

examples.en: The student event served nonalcoholic mulled cider with biscuits in the lounge that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，学生活动在休息室供应无酒精的「热香料苹果饮」和饼干。

words.enDefinition: The solstice marking the shortest day of the year in a hemisphere.

examples.en: Our lecturer used the winter solstice to explain why the days felt so short.
examples.zh: 老师用「冬至」来解释为什么那时白昼感觉这么短。

examples.en: I saw a poster for a winter solstice event at the community garden near campus.
examples.zh: 我在校园附近的社区花园看到一张「冬至」活动海报。

words.enDefinition: The beginning of a lunisolar year, celebrated in a number of East and Southeast Asian traditions.

examples.en: Our student center hosted a Lunar New Year event with displays on several different traditions.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心办了「农历新年」活动，展示了几种不同的习俗。

examples.en: Some of my classmates mark Lunar New Year at home, while others go to local gatherings.
examples.zh: 有些同学在家庆祝「农历新年」，有些会去参加当地的聚会。

collocations: travel home for Lunar New Year

words.enDefinition: the Chinese celebration marking the new year in the traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar

examples.en: I went to a Spring Festival performance in town with friends from my language class.
examples.zh: 我和语言课的朋友去城里看了「春节」演出。

examples.en: My roommate showed us photos of her family preparing for the Spring Festival back home.
examples.zh: 室友给我们看了她家人在家乡准备过「春节」的照片。

collocations: travel home for the Spring Festival

words.enDefinition: A greeting for someone celebrating the start of a new year in a lunisolar calendar.

examples.en: The library put up a banner reading “Happy Lunar New Year” beside the information desk.
examples.zh: 图书馆在咨询台旁挂了条写着「农历新年快乐」的横幅。

examples.en: Our tutor wrote “Happy Lunar New Year” at the end of the weekly class email.
examples.zh: 导师在每周课程邮件末尾写了「农历新年快乐」。

collocations: wish someone a Happy Lunar New Year
a banner reading Happy Lunar New Year

words.enDefinition: A calendar that uses lunar months and keeps the year aligned with the seasons.

examples.en: Our lecturer explained the lunisolar calendar when someone asked why the festival's date moves.
examples.zh: 有人问节日日期为什么会变，老师就讲了「阴阳历」。

examples.en: The exhibition compared a lunisolar calendar with the calendar on our campus noticeboard to illustrate the difference.
examples.zh: 展览用一种「阴阳历」和校园公告栏上的日历作对照，来说明二者的差别。

words.enDefinition: The last evening or day before the new year begins in a lunisolar calendar.

examples.en: We called our relatives on Lunar New Year's Eve before joining our roommates for dinner.
examples.zh: 「农历新年前夕」，我们先给亲戚打了电话，再和室友一起吃饭。

examples.en: On Lunar New Year's Eve, my classmate video-called her relatives in Vietnam from our lounge.
examples.zh: 「农历新年前夕」，同学在休息室和越南的亲戚打了视频电话。

collocations: a Lunar New Year's Eve dinner
gather on Lunar New Year's Eve

words.enDefinition: A family meal held to reunite relatives, often on Chinese New Year's Eve.

examples.en: My roommate joined her family's reunion dinner on video while eating with us on campus.
examples.zh: 室友在学校跟我们吃饭时，通过视频参加了家里的「年夜团圆饭」。

examples.en: We invited friends who could not go home to a reunion dinner on Chinese New Year’s Eve.
examples.zh: 中国春节除夕，我们邀请没能回家的朋友一起吃「年夜团圆饭」。

collocations: return home for a reunion dinner

words.enDefinition: A small red packet used to give money on occasions such as Lunar New Year.

examples.en: A classmate showed me a red envelope his grandmother had given him for the holiday.
examples.zh: 同学给我看了奶奶过节时给他的一个「红包」。

examples.en: We made a paper red envelope at the library's Lunar New Year activity table.
examples.zh: 我们在图书馆的农历新年活动桌上做了一个纸「红包」。

collocations: a red envelope with lucky money

words.enDefinition: A Chinese cycle of twelve animals used to represent years and other time divisions.

examples.en: The campus exhibit included a diagram showing the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac.
examples.zh: 校园展上有一张图，展示了「中国生肖体系」里的十二种动物。

examples.en: My neighbor explained the Chinese zodiac while we looked through her collection of festival stamps.
examples.zh: 我们翻看邻居收藏的节日邮票时，她介绍了「中国生肖体系」。

collocations: a display about the Chinese zodiac

words.enDefinition: An animal assigned to a year in a cycle such as the Chinese zodiac.

examples.en: We each picked a zodiac animal to draw on a card for the campus festival.
examples.zh: 我们各挑了一种「生肖动物」，画到校园节庆活动的卡片上。

examples.en: My roommate asked which zodiac animal the picture represented on the museum's poster beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 室友问，博物馆入口旁海报上的图画代表哪一种「生肖动物」。

collocations: a picture of each zodiac animal

words.enDefinition: A year associated with the dragon in the twelve-animal zodiac cycle used in China and elsewhere.

examples.en: The stamp case showed a red design from a past Year of the Dragon.
examples.zh: 邮票陈列柜里有一枚往年「龙年」的红色邮票。

examples.en: One poster used the Year of the Dragon to introduce visitors to the zodiac cycle.
examples.zh: 有张海报从「龙年」讲起，为访客介绍生肖循环。

collocations: celebrate the Year of the Dragon
a Year of the Dragon stamp
a Year of the Dragon display

words.enDefinition: A pair of matching lines with festive wishes displayed at Chinese New Year.

examples.en: We read a Spring Festival couplet with help from the students at the calligraphy table.
examples.zh: 书法桌旁的同学帮我们读了一副「春联」。

examples.en: My classmate photographed a Spring Festival couplet beside her family's doorway before returning to campus.
examples.zh: 返校前，同学拍下了家门边的一副「春联」。

collocations: a Spring Festival couplet on red paper

words.enDefinition: A red inscription bearing New Year wishes, known as fai chun in Cantonese.

examples.en: We saw a display of fai chun written by Hong Kong students in the library.
examples.zh: 我们在图书馆看见香港同学书写的「挥春」展品。

examples.en: My classmate explained the wishes on the fai chun in her family's holiday photograph.
examples.zh: 同学给我解释了她家节日照片里「挥春」上的祝福。

collocations: display fai chun at the door

words.enDefinition: A traditional Chinese craft using cut paper to make patterns, often for festivals.

examples.en: The museum included Chinese paper cutting in its display of Lunar New Year window decorations.
examples.zh: 博物馆在农历新年的窗饰展览里展示了「中国剪纸」。

examples.en: A student demonstrated Chinese paper cutting at the craft table next to our exhibition.
examples.zh: 一位同学在我们展览旁的手工桌上演示了「中国剪纸」。

collocations: an example of Chinese paper cutting

words.enDefinition: A lantern with a red covering, commonly seen at some Lunar New Year celebrations.

examples.en: We noticed a red lantern hanging above the door of the neighborhood community center.
examples.zh: 我们留意到社区中心门上挂着一只「红灯笼」。

examples.en: The campus craft booth displayed a red lantern made by students for their New Year event.
examples.zh: 校园手工摊位展出了一只同学们为新年活动做的「红灯笼」。

words.enDefinition: A public procession marking Lunar New Year with performances or decorated displays.

examples.en: My roommate and I watched the Lunar New Year parade near our usual bus stop.
examples.zh: 我和室友在常去的公交站旁看了「农历新年巡游」。

examples.en: The student band was invited to play in the Lunar New Year parade downtown this winter.
examples.zh: 学生乐队受邀在这个冬天的市中心「农历新年巡游」上演出。

collocations: watch a Lunar New Year parade
take part in a Lunar New Year parade
a route for the Lunar New Year parade

words.enDefinition: A traditional performance in which dancers move together inside a lion costume.

examples.en: We heard drums outside the student center shortly before the lion dance began that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午「舞狮」开始前不久，我们听见学生活动中心外传来鼓声。

examples.en: A visiting troupe performed a lion dance beside the community market for the New Year event.
examples.zh: 一个受邀团队在社区集市旁为新年活动表演了「舞狮」。

words.enDefinition: A traditional performance in which a team moves a long dragon figure in coordinated patterns.

examples.en: We watched the dragon dance curve past the community center during the festival procession.
examples.zh: 节庆巡游时，我们看着「舞龙」队伍蜿蜒经过社区中心。

examples.en: My classmate pointed out the dragon dance team waiting near the entrance to the fair.
examples.zh: 同学指给我看在集市入口旁等候的「舞龙」队。

words.enDefinition: A Chinese festival on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, associated with lanterns.

examples.en: Students hung lanterns in the common room for their Lantern Festival gathering after class.
examples.zh: 同学们下课后在公共休息室挂灯笼，准备举办「元宵节」聚会。

examples.en: We read about the Lantern Festival in a booklet at the winter culture fair.
examples.zh: 我们在冬季文化集市的一本小册子里读到了「元宵节」。

words.enDefinition: A riddle displayed on a lantern or nearby for people to solve at a celebration.

examples.en: We tried to solve a lantern riddle before my classmate read out the answer.
examples.zh: 同学读出答案前，我们试着猜那道「灯谜」。

examples.en: An exchange student wrote a lantern riddle for the festival table outside the library.
examples.zh: 一位交换生给图书馆外的节日摊位写了一道「灯谜」。

collocations: guess the answer to a lantern riddle

words.enDefinition: Glutinous rice balls often served at the Chinese Lantern Festival, commonly with sweet fillings or syrup.

examples.en: My classmate brought a bowl of tangyuan to our small Lantern Festival gathering on campus.
examples.zh: 同学带来一碗「汤圆」，参加我们在学校办的小型元宵聚会。

examples.en: The cafe's handwritten menu listed tangyuan as a dessert during the winter culture fair.
examples.zh: 冬季文化集市期间，咖啡馆的手写菜单把「汤圆」列为一道甜点。

words.enDefinition: A rice cake commonly eaten during the Chinese New Year, with many regional varieties.

examples.en: We tried nian gao at the student food table during the Lunar New Year event.
examples.zh: 农历新年活动期间，我们在学生美食摊位尝了「中式年糕」。

examples.en: My neighbor showed me how her family's nian gao differs from the kind at the market.
examples.zh: 邻居给我看她家的「中式年糕」和集市上的那种有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: A seasonal market selling festive plants and decorations, held in places such as Hong Kong.

examples.en: My flatmate showed us photos from a Lunar New Year flower market in Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 室友给我们看了她在香港「农历新年花市」拍的照片。

examples.en: The culture club's display featured a stall sign from a Lunar New Year flower market.
examples.zh: 文化社的展览中有一块从「农历新年花市」来的摊位招牌。

collocations: visit a Lunar New Year flower market
browse a Lunar New Year flower market
a stall at a Lunar New Year flower market

words.enDefinition: A Mandarin New Year greeting wishing someone prosperity.

examples.en: A card reading “Gong Xi Fa Cai” stood above the sweets at the student fair.
examples.zh: 学生集市的糖果上方有张卡片，写着「恭喜发财」。

examples.en: My classmate showed us how to pronounce “Gong Xi Fa Cai” for the New Year event.
examples.zh: 同学教我们在新年活动上怎么念「恭喜发财」。

collocations: a card that reads Gong Xi Fa Cai

words.enDefinition: The Vietnamese Lunar New Year holiday, often marked by family visits and seasonal foods.

examples.en: Our Vietnamese classmate brought photos from her family's Tết celebrations to share with the seminar.
examples.zh: 越南同学带了她家过「越南农历新年」的照片，跟研讨班分享。

examples.en: The student society offered a short talk about Tết before lunch in the common room.
examples.zh: 学生社团在公共休息室开午饭前，安排了一场关于「越南农历新年」的简短分享。

words.enDefinition: A Vietnamese greeting wishing someone a happy new year.

examples.en: We wrote “Chúc mừng năm mới” on a card for our Vietnamese neighbors.
examples.zh: 我们在给越南邻居的卡片上写了「越南语的新年快乐」。

examples.en: A banner saying “Chúc mừng năm mới” hung above the student society table.
examples.zh: 学生社团的桌子上方挂着横幅，写的是「越南语的新年快乐」。

collocations: a sign reading Chúc mừng năm mới
write Chúc mừng năm mới on a card

words.enDefinition: A square parcel of glutinous rice and savory filling wrapped in leaves, associated with Tết.

examples.en: My classmate shared bánh chưng with us at the Vietnamese New Year gathering on campus.
examples.zh: 校园越南新年聚会上，同学跟我们分享了「越南方形糯米粽」。

examples.en: The exhibit displayed bánh chưng beside a photo showing how it looks when sliced.
examples.zh: 展览展出了「越南方形糯米粽」，旁边有一张照片展示它切开后的样子。

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical leaf-wrapped glutinous rice cake associated with Tết, especially in southern Vietnam.

examples.en: Our neighbor brought bánh tét to the winter gathering and shared slices with our study group.
examples.zh: 邻居带了「越南长筒形糯米粽」来参加冬季聚会，切片分给了我们自习小组。

examples.en: The student presenter used a photo of bánh tét to explain a tradition from southern Vietnam.
examples.zh: 做展示的同学用一张「越南长筒形糯米粽」的照片来讲越南南方的一项习俗。

collocations: cut a slice of bánh tét

words.enDefinition: Lucky money given at Tết in Vietnam, often in a red envelope.

examples.en: My flatmate explained lì xì while showing us a red envelope from her family's Tết celebration.
examples.zh: 室友给我们看她家过越南新年的红包时，介绍了「越南新年压岁钱」。

examples.en: The talk described how relatives in one family gave lì xì to their younger cousins.
examples.zh: 分享中讲到，有一家亲戚会给年纪小的表亲发「越南新年压岁钱」。

collocations: a red envelope holding lì xì

words.enDefinition: Candied fruit, roots, or other sweet preserved treats served during Tết.

examples.en: We tried mứt Tết at the culture fair after our class finished for the day.
examples.zh: 当天课程结束后，我们在文化集市尝了「越南新年蜜饯」。

examples.en: My classmate brought a tray of mứt Tết to share with friends in the lounge.
examples.zh: 同学把一盘「越南新年蜜饯」带到休息室跟朋友分享。

words.enDefinition: Yellow flowers used as festive decorations for Tết, especially in southern Vietnam.

examples.en: My flatmate showed us yellow apricot blossoms in a photo from her hometown's Tết market.
examples.zh: 室友给我们看了她家乡越南新年集市照片里的「越南黄梅花」。

examples.en: The exhibit used paper yellow apricot blossoms to illustrate a Tết decoration from southern Vietnam.
examples.zh: 这个展览用纸制「越南黄梅花」来展示一种越南南方的新年装饰。

collocations: a branch of yellow apricot blossoms
a vase of yellow apricot blossoms

words.enDefinition: A Vietnamese Tết custom centered on the first visitor to a home in the new year.

examples.en: Our classmate explained xông đất when we compared different ways of welcoming the new year.
examples.zh: 我们比较各地迎新年的方式时，同学介绍了「越南新年首访习俗」。

examples.en: A short note about xông đất appeared in the booklet from our student cultural event.
examples.zh: 学生文化活动的小册子里有一段关于「越南新年首访习俗」的简短说明。

collocations: explain the custom of xông đất

words.enDefinition: The Korean Lunar New Year holiday, often marked by family gatherings or visits.

examples.en: The campus Korean society invited students to a Seollal event in the common room.
examples.zh: 校园韩国文化社邀请同学们到公共休息室参加「韩国农历新年」活动。

examples.en: My roommate called her family in Korea for Seollal while we were studying abroad.
examples.zh: 我们在海外留学时，室友为过「韩国农历新年」给韩国的家人打了电话。

words.enDefinition: A formal bow to elders traditionally made during the Korean Lunar New Year.

examples.en: A student described sebae during our class discussion of Korean Lunar New Year customs.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论韩国农历新年习俗时，有位同学介绍了「韩国新年向长辈行礼」。

examples.en: My neighbor explained sebae while showing us photographs from her family's celebration of Seollal.
examples.zh: 邻居给我们看她家过韩国农历新年的照片时，讲了「韩国新年向长辈行礼」。

words.enDefinition: Money some Korean elders give younger relatives after receiving a New Year bow.

examples.en: My classmate talked about receiving sebaetdon during Seollal visits to her grandparents when she was younger.
examples.zh: 同学讲了她小时候过韩国农历新年去看祖父母时领到「韩国新年压岁钱」的经历。

examples.en: The family traditions display mentioned sebaetdon alongside photographs of several generations celebrating Seollal together.
examples.zh: 家庭习俗展介绍了「韩国新年压岁钱」，旁边配有几代人同庆韩国农历新年的照片。

words.enDefinition: Korean soup with sliced rice cakes, often served during Seollal.

examples.en: We tried tteokguk with friends at an event organized by the campus Korean society.
examples.zh: 我们在校园韩国文化社举办的活动上和朋友一起尝了「韩国年糕汤」。

examples.en: My flatmate shared photos of tteokguk that her relatives had made during the holiday.
examples.zh: 室友分享了亲戚在过节时做的「韩国年糕汤」照片。

words.enDefinition: Traditional Korean clothing worn on special occasions such as Seollal.

examples.en: The campus exhibit displayed hanbok beside photographs of Korean families celebrating the new year.
examples.zh: 校园展览把「韩服」摆在韩国各家庭庆祝新年的照片旁。

examples.en: A classmate showed us the hanbok her aunt had worn at their Seollal gathering.
examples.zh: 有位同学给我们看了她姨妈在韩国农历新年聚会时穿的「韩服」。

words.enDefinition: A traditional Korean board game using four sticks, often played during Seollal.

examples.en: Some students played yutnori at the activity table during the Korean New Year event.
examples.zh: 韩国新年活动中，几位同学在活动桌上玩了「韩国掷柶棋」。

examples.en: My flatmate recognized yutnori from the sticks shown in a photograph outside the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 室友从阶梯教室外照片里的小棍认出了「韩国掷柶棋」。

words.enDefinition: A polite Korean greeting wishing someone much good fortune in the new year.

examples.en: My classmate practiced saying “Saehae bok mani badeuseyo” before calling her grandparents for Seollal.
examples.zh: 同学在给祖父母打电话拜年之前，练习说「韩语的新年多福」。

examples.en: A sign at the Korean club's table read “Saehae bok mani badeuseyo” above its translation.
examples.zh: 韩国文化社的桌上摆着牌子，译文上方写的是「韩语的新年多福」。

collocations: a card reading Saehae bok mani badeuseyo

words.enDefinition: The communal tossing of yusheng to wish for good fortune, especially in Singapore and Malaysia.

examples.en: A classmate from Singapore introduced lo hei at our Lunar New Year gathering on campus.
examples.zh: 一位新加坡同学在我们的校园农历新年聚会上介绍了「新年捞生习俗」。

examples.en: Our neighbor showed us a video of lo hei from her relatives' celebration in Malaysia.
examples.zh: 邻居给我们看了一段视频，里面是她在马来西亚的亲戚过节时「新年捞生」的场景。
